target_address.description: The IPv6 address of the node to lookup the link-layer address for.

interface.description: The network interface name on which to send the solicitation.

source_address.description: The source IPv6 address to use for the packets. Empty string uses automatic selection.

max_attempts.description: Number of times to retry sending the ICMPv6 Neighbor Solicitation.

retry_wait_ms.description: Time in milliseconds to wait for a response before retrying.

numeric_only.description: If true, do not try to resolve the target address as a DNS hostname.

quiet_mode.description: If true, only display the link-layer address and suppress error messages.

single_mode.description: If true, exit as soon as the first advertisement is received.

verbose.description: If true, display verbose information. Default is true unless quiet is set.
